name: iConvert Optimizer
author: iConvert

sections.description:
iConvert Optimizer lets you run A/B split tests on WordPress pages and WooCommerce block templates without writing a single line of code.

Create multiple variations of a page, define how traffic is distributed between them, choose your success metric, and let the plugin do the rest. Clear statistics show you exactly which variation is winning.

Key Features

  • A/B test WordPress pages and WooCommerce templates — run split tests on any page or on WooCommerce block templates: Shop, Single Product, Cart, Checkout, and My Account.
  • Flexible conversion goals — measure what matters: button clicks, newsletter sign-ups, completed orders (PRO), or revenue above a target amount (PRO).
  • Smart traffic splitting — set the percentage for each variation and the plugin automatically keeps the actual served ratio on target.
  • Instant results dashboard — see impressions, conversions, and conversion rates per variation at a glance.
  • Scheduling — set a start and end date for a test, or run it manually.
  • Role-based exclusion — prevent specific user roles (e.g. administrators) from being entered into a test.
  • One-click variation duplication — duplicate any page or block template to create a new variation instantly.
  • Live preview — preview any variation in context without affecting live traffic.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with the Block Editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. iConvert Optimizer fully supports block-theme templates and the Site Editor. You can A/B test WooCommerce block templates (Cart, Checkout, Shop archive, Single product, My Account) as well as the Homepage and Blog templates.

How is traffic split between variations?

You assign a percentage to each variation. The plugin tracks daily display counts per variation and always serves the one that is furthest behind its target percentage, so the actual served ratio converges on your configured split over time.

Will visitors always see the same variation?

Yes. Once a visitor has been assigned a variation, their assignment is stored in a session cookie. They will continue to see the same variation for the duration of the test.

Can I exclude logged-in users or administrators from tests?

Yes. In the test editor you can select one or more WordPress user roles to exclude from the test. Excluded users will always see the original (control) page.

Does it track WooCommerce revenue?

WooCommerce revenue and order-placed conversion goals are available in the PRO version. Set a revenue threshold and a conversion is only counted when the order subtotal meets or exceeds that value.

Where can I find the source code?

The complete source code for this plugin is available on GitHub: https://github.com/extendthemes/iconvert-optimizer-public
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Added support for WordPress 7.2.
  • The minimum required WordPress version is now 7.0.
  • Security: split tests can only be read and changed by administrators, through the REST API too.
  • Security: a variation is always created as a copy of the test source, never of another page of the site.
  • Security: variation previews are shown only to administrators.
  • Security: the plugin notices are sanitized, and shown only to administrators.
  • Fixed the status label, the variation buttons and the disabled fields of the admin screens on WordPress 7.2.
  • Fixed the notifications check stopping other scheduled tasks when the notifications server could not be reached.

1.1.0

  • Added support for WordPress 7.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
